fusions.name: Cloudburst Slam
fusions.desc: Slams the ground, dealing 12 water damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Soaked] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Thunderhead
fusions.desc: Hurls a charged mass that deals 30 lightning damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Shocked] for 4 seconds, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Washed Clear
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you.

fusions.name: Rising Level
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you are healed for 3% of your maximum health per stack (24% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
